name: Workshop Basics
description: Help the elder mechanic on the mountain with fabrication work.|A veteran crafter needs supply runs completed. In return, you'll be taught how to use crafting benches.

text: I can teach you, but you'll need to bring me some materials first.
I'll teach you how to make starter gear.
First bring me some string, you can craft it by finding blue lilies.
Secondly I will need some beryl, you can find it in various caves.
You can use the crafting table to make a Beryl Pendant.
completedText: Bring string and beryl, then craft a pendant.

hasItemText: Wonderful, now you can use crafting in combination with other skills
to create more complex items. Fletch a small bowl and bring it to me.
completedText: Fletch me a small bowl and bring it to me.

hasItemText: Perfect, I'm taking that bowl for testing. Go make another
one and use this tomato to make a stew using the cauldron.
You may need to go find the rest of the ingredients, I'm getting old.
completedText: Try making a stew using a bowl, a tomato, and the cauldron.

hasItemText: Wonderful, see, you're getting the hang of it.
